# LBM

# 1. Prepare data

## D1

```{r}
### 16S

ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- Charge_xl_to_ps("ps_16S_rare_expe_D1", folder_path=file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data", "3_CommunityComposition", "Dataset_1"))

# Filter data (exclude host fruits)
ps_16S_rare_expe_D1 <- Subset_physeq(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, SampleType %in%  c("Mothers_0days", "Mothers_2days", "Larvae","Pupae","Daughters"))

# counts -> presence/absence (binary table)
ps_rare_16S_D1_bin = phyloseq::transform_sample_counts(ps_16S_rare_expe_D1, function(x) 1*(x>0)) 

## Extract metadata
mtd_D1_16S <- data.frame(phyloseq::sample_data(ps_rare_16S_D1_bin))
mtd_D1_16S <- mtd_D1_16S %>%
  dplyr::rename(Sample = ID_pool)

## Extract taxonomy table
df_taxo_D1_16S = as.data.frame(tax_table(ps_rare_16S_D1_bin))
df_taxo_D1_16S$tax_ID = rownames(df_taxo_D1_16S)

## Extract table with presence/absence
df_reads_D1_16S = as.data.frame(otu_table(ps_rare_16S_D1_bin)) 
df_reads_D1_16S = as.data.frame(df_reads_D1_16S)
df_reads_D1_16S$tax_ID = rownames(df_reads_D1_16S)
## Merge table with presence/absence and taxonomy
df_wide_D1_16S <- dplyr::left_join(df_taxo_D1_16S, df_reads_D1_16S, by = "tax_ID") #merge the two (suppr "Species" column)
df_wide_D1_16S$Species <- NULL

## Remove taxonomy other than Genus
BF_D1_16S <- df_wide_D1_16S[, c(6,8:dim(df_wide_D1_16S)[2])] #subset + genus as row names + sample names as column names + transposematrix
BF_D1_16S$Genus <- make.unique(BF_D1_16S$Genus, sep = "_")
rownames(BF_D1_16S) <- BF_D1_16S$Genus 
BF_D1_16S$Genus <- NULL
colnames(BF_D1_16S) <- mtd_D1_16S$Sample[match(colnames(BF_D1_16S), mtd_D1_16S$Sample)]
## Transpose matrix
FB_D1_16S <- t(BF_D1_16S)
## Export
write.csv(FB_D1_16S, file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data","5_SBMclustering", "Dataset_1", "FB_D1_16S.csv"), row.names = TRUE)
```

#2. LBM clustering

## D1

### 16S

```{r}
#Charge matrix
FB_D1_16S <- read.csv(file = file.path(here::here(), "data", "derived_data","5_SBMclustering", "Dataset_1", "FB_D1_16S.csv"),header=TRUE, sep=",", row.names = 1)

#LBM calculation
SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1 <-  as.matrix(FB_D1_16S) %>%
  sbm::estimateBipartiteSBM(model = 'bernoulli')

memb_spl_obs_16S_D1 <- SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1$memberships$row
memb_otu_obs_16S_D1 <- SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1$memberships$col

SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1$storedModels %>% dplyr::arrange(ICL)
 
#Plots
SBM_16S_D1_FruitType <- Order_Matrix_Plot2(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1, BF_mat = BF_D1_16S, mtd = mtd_D1_16S, variable_name = "FruitType", modality_string = c("BL", "CH","na", "ST"), color_string = c("purple4", "red4","grey", "red2"), legend_name = "Fruit of Origin") #"na","grey",  

title_plot <- "SBM_NF_D1_16S_FruitType_ordered.png"

cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", "Dataset_1", title_plot), SBM_16S_D1_FruitType, base_height = 20/cm(1),  base_width = 40/cm(1), dpi = 1200)


SBM_16S_D1_SampleType <- Order_Matrix_Plot2(SBMobject = SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1, BF_mat = BF_D1_16S, mtd = mtd_D1_16S, variable_name = "SampleType", modality_string = c( "Mothers_0days","Mothers_2days",  "Larvae", "Pupae",  "Daughters"), color_string = c( "goldenrod2", "#8B4500","red2", "red3","darkorange2"), legend_name = "Type of Sample")   

title_plot <- "SBM_NF_D1_16S_SampleTypeordered.png"

cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", "Dataset_1", title_plot), SBM_16S_D1_SampleType, base_height = 20/cm(1),  base_width = 40/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
```

```{r}
# Combined LBM plots
SBM_expe_FruitType_combined <- 
  (SBM_16S_D1_FruitType + labs(tag = "A. Bacteria")) /
  (SBM_ITS_expe_FruitType + labs(tag = "B. Fungi")) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1) & theme(legend.position = "right", plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

  (SBM_16S_D1_SampleType + labs(tag = "A. Bacteria")) /
  (SBM_ITS_expe_SampleType + labs(tag = "B. Fungi")) +
  plot_layout(ncol = 1) & theme(legend.position = "right", plot.tag = element_text(size = 12, face = "bold"))

title_plot <- "SBM_NF_D1_SampleType_combined.png"

 cowplot::save_plot(file =here::here("plots", "5_SBM&co", "Dataset_1", title_plot), SBM_expe_SampleType_combined, base_height = 26/cm(1),  base_width = 34.7/cm(1), dpi = 1200)  
```

# alluvial plot 16S

```{r}
## Extract rows (samples) and columns (OTUs) for the alluvial plot
memb_spl_obs_16S_D1 <- SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1$memberships$row
memb_otu_obs_16S_D1 <- SBM_bernoulli_16S_D1$memberships$col

## Data for alluvial plot : Compute SampleSize, the number of samples for each FruitType, SampleType and OTU membership
dataalluvial_16S_expe_FruitType_SampleType <- as.data.frame(table(sample_data(ps_rare_16S_expe_bin)$FruitType,
      memb_spl_obs_16S_expe, sample_data(ps_rare_16S_expe_bin)$SampleType))

colnames(dataalluvial_16S_expe_FruitType_SampleType) = c("FruitType", "Bacteria",  "SampleType", "SampleSize") # change column names

# plot for fruits
Alluvial_16S_expe_FruitType_SampleType <- dataalluvial_16S_expe_FruitType_SampleType |>
  ggplot(aes(axis1 = FruitType,
             axis2 = Bacteria,
             axis3 = SampleType,
             y = SampleSize)) +
  ggalluvial::geom_alluvium(aes(fill = FruitType), alpha = 0.6) +
  ggalluvial::geom_stratum(width = 0.4) +
  geom_text(stat = "stratum",
            aes(label = after_stat(stratum))) +
  scale_x_discrete(limits = c("Fruit Type", "Bacteria", "Sample Type"), expand = c(.2, .05)) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("BL" = "purple4", "CH" = "red4","na" = "grey",  "ST" = "red2"),guide = "none") +
  theme_minimal()+
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(size = 12, color = "black", face = "bold"))

title_plot <- "AlluvialPlot_Expe_FruitTYpe_SampleType_16S.jpg"
 cowplot::save_plot(file=here::here("plots", "5_LBM&co", title_plot), Alluvial_16S_expe_FruitType_SampleType, base_height = 30/cm(1), base_width = 50/cm(1), dpi = 1200)
 
```
